safeZones._: إنستجرام بيغطي أطراف الستوري بواجهته. سيب المناطق دي فاضية من أي تفصيلة مهمة.
safeZones.typography: 18%–52% من أعلى الإطار — لازم تكون سطح هادي (جدار جبس أو سقف) عشان النص يقرا

lock._: منقول من vibe.json — أي فريم يخرج عن ده هيبان إنه من شوت تاني
lock.grade: warm neutral only — cream, plaster, taupe, walnut, stone. No cool tones, no teal, no grey-blue
lock.lens: 35mm architectural, verticals kept perfectly straight, no distortion
lock.camera: static, eye level, near one-point perspective
lock.signature: one warm practical light source visible or implied in every frame

negative: no people, no text, no lettering, no signage, no watermarks, no logos, no CGI showroom gloss, no HDR, no fisheye, no teal-and-orange grade, no lens flare, no clutter crowding the walls, no cool grey or blue tones, no tilted verticals

stories.prompt: Vertical 9:16 architectural photograph of an unoccupied contemporary Saudi bedroom, warm minimal. Lime plaster walls in soft cream, a full-height walnut headboard panel, a low bed dressed in natural linen with cream boucle upholstery, a honed travertine bedside table, and a slim brushed brass reading lamp casting a warm glow. Soft directional daylight enters from one large window out of frame to the left, laying long gentle shadows across a pale stone floor. Composition: the upper 45 percent of the tall frame is a single uninterrupted plaster wall, completely empty and flat; the room occupies the lower half. Shot on Kodak Portra 400, 35mm architectural lens, verticals perfectly straight, static eye-level near one-point perspective. Warm neutral palette only — cream, plaster, taupe, walnut, stone. Photographic, film grain, no CGI gloss. No people, no text, no signage.

stories.prompt: Vertical 9:16 architectural photograph of the exterior facade of a contemporary Saudi villa, about an hour before sunset but in clear air. Clean stacked massing in warm limestone and cream plaster, deep shaded window reveals, a walnut-toned timber screen shading the entrance, a solid walnut door, and one warm light glowing in the recessed entry. Low desert planting and a pale stone forecourt at the base. The sky is clean pale cream, almost white near the horizon — no dust haze, no heavy golden or amber cast. Soft raking side light, long gentle shadows across the plaster, low contrast. Composition: the building mass sits LOW in the frame — the upper 45 percent is open, evenly toned empty sky with no rooflines or trees intruding into it. Shot on Kodak Portra 400, 35mm architectural lens, verticals perfectly straight, static eye-level near one-point perspective. Warm neutral palette that matches a cream-plaster interior shot from the same set — limestone, cream, taupe, walnut. Photographic, film grain, no CGI gloss. No people, no cars, no text, no signage, no house numbers.
stories.why: خارجي — القفل الأصلي داخلي بس، فبدّلت الإضاءة لشمس مائلة متأخرة وحافظت على باقي القواعد
